claims.statement: For every full-column-rank physical shield M0 and arbitrary Boolean core D(u,z) with two physical kernel coordinates z, H(P)<=2I(P) and U(P)<=2I(P), uniformly in all parameters.

Uniform FEI, U-endpoint, or GU' bounds on aligned arbitrary-nullity shields imply the corresponding universal inequality with the same constants, via q_r times tensor powers of an arbitrary Boolean seed.
No dimension-independent universal control of aggregate upper-set asymmetry mismatch is proved; nullity-two FEI is not restriction closed, and arbitrary-nullity parameter removal is GU'/FEI-hard.
